about.title: The Art of Jewellery,
about.lead: {store} celebrates the beauty of jewellery through timeless designs, elegant craftsmanship and a passion for making every occasion memorable.
about.imageAlt: A woman in an ivory saree adjusting a gold jhumka earring

story.title: Jewellery that belongs
story.first: Every celebration has a piece of jewellery at its heart: the necklace chosen for a wedding, the jhumkas worn to a festival, the ring that marks a promise. {store} exists to help you find those pieces.
story.second: We bring together necklaces, earrings, jhumkas, bangles, bracelets and rings inspired by Indian tradition, chosen for how they look, how they feel and how they make you feel.
story.imageAlt: A woman wearing a ring set with a purple stone

philosophy.title: Tradition, worn your way
philosophy.body: We believe heritage designs deserve a place in modern life. Temple motifs, kundan settings and pearl drops are chosen to pair as beautifully with a silk saree as with everyday wear.

quality.title: Our Commitment to Quality
quality.body: Each piece is checked for its finish, its stones and its shine before it reaches you.

craft.title: Traditional Craftsmanship
craft.body: We favour designs rooted in Indian jewellery traditions: temple work, kundan, filigree and pearl.

promise.title: Our Promise to Customers
promise.body: Clear prices, honest photos, secure payments and real people ready to help on WhatsApp.

about.craftImageAlt: A woman wearing a gold kada and matching earrings
